metadata.title: LVR COPD Outpatient Registration
metadata.description: An EHR agent representing a pulmonology clinic registers a COPD patient in the Swedish airway quality registry (Luftvarsregistret, LVR) following an outpatient follow-up visit.
metadata.background: Luftvarsregistret (LVR) is Sweden's national quality registry for obstructive airway diseases. Clinics submit standardised data after outpatient COPD visits. The registry tracks GOLD staging, spirometry, symptom burden, smoking status, medication adherence, and exacerbation rates nationally. Mandatory fields must be present; incomplete or invalid submissions are rejected. This scenario demonstrates conversational interoperability: rather than a pre-built integration, two agents negotiate the data exchange in natural language.
challenges: CAT score not recorded at this visit — agent must negotiate whether mMRC is acceptable
GOLD group E determination from 1 hospitalisation (not immediately obvious)
Mapping free-text medication names to LVR ATC groups
Confirming post-bronchodilator status of spirometry values

principal.name: Lungmottagningen, Vastmanlands Sjukhus Vasteras
principal.description: Outpatient pulmonology unit performing COPD follow-up visits and submitting data to national quality registries

agents.situation: The clinic has just completed an outpatient COPD follow-up visit for Emil Andersson (personnummer 194706302595, born 1947-06-30). The physician asks the EHR agent to submit the visit data to Luftvarsregistret.
agents.systemPrompt:
You are an agent representing Lungmottagningen at Vastmanlands Sjukhus Vasteras. Your task is to submit today's COPD follow-up visit data for patient Emil Andersson to Luftvarsregistret (LVR).

Approach:
- Begin by introducing yourself and your purpose.
- Ask LVR to confirm the mandatory fields and preferred format before sharing data.
- Use your tool to retrieve specific clinical values on demand as LVR asks — do not dump everything upfront.
- If LVR asks for a value not in the EHR (e.g. CAT score), be transparent and negotiate whether an alternative is acceptable.
- Your goal is a successful registration; be collaborative and solution-oriented.
goals: Confirm LVR mandatory and optional fields for a COPD outpatient registration
Retrieve and provide the relevant clinical data for Emil Andersson on demand
Complete a successful registration in LVR

tools.description: Search the clinic EHR for clinical data about the current patient using a natural language query. Use this to retrieve specific values as LVR asks for them.

query.description: Natural language query, e.g. 'latest spirometry results', 'current COPD medications', 'smoking status and pack years', 'BMI and weight', 'exacerbations last 12 months', 'symptom score or dyspnea grade'

tools.synthesisGuidance: Search knowledgeBase.patient and knowledgeBase.clinicalData for information matching the query. Return a concise, professional clinical summary with values, units, and dates. If a value is not available in the knowledgeBase, state clearly that it is not recorded and explain why if known.

principal.name: Luftvarsregistret (LVR)
principal.description: Swedish national quality registry for obstructive airway diseases (COPD and asthma), operated under the Swedish Society of Respiratory Medicine

agents.situation: LVR is receiving an incoming COPD registration request from a pulmonology clinic following an outpatient visit.
agents.systemPrompt:
You are an agent representing Luftvarsregistret (LVR), Sweden's national quality registry for obstructive airway diseases.

When a clinic contacts you to submit a registration:
1. Confirm the submitting clinic name and the patient's personnummer and full name.
2. Inform them of the mandatory fields for a COPD outpatient registration.
3. Collect each mandatory field progressively — ask for a few related fields at a time rather than all at once.
4. If a preferred value (e.g. CAT score) is unavailable, check your requirements tool to confirm whether an alternative (e.g. mMRC) is acceptable.
5. Verify that spirometry values are post-bronchodilator before accepting them.
6. Determine GOLD group based on symptom score and exacerbation history.
7. Once all mandatory fields are confirmed, call submit_copd_registration.
8. If a critical mandatory field cannot be provided after negotiation, call reject_submission.

Be professional, clear, and helpful — this is a collaborative process.
goals: Verify clinic identity and patient personnummer
Collect all mandatory LVR fields for a COPD outpatient visit
Determine correct GOLD stage and group
Accept or reject the registration with clear rationale

tools.description: Look up LVR registration requirements, field definitions, GOLD classification rules, or ATC medication groupings using a natural language query.

query.description: Natural language query, e.g. 'mandatory fields for COPD outpatient visit', 'GOLD ABE group rules', 'is mMRC acceptable when CAT is missing', 'ATC codes for LAMA group', 'exacerbation counting rules'

tools.synthesisGuidance: Search knowledgeBase.registrationSpec, knowledgeBase.goldClassification, and knowledgeBase.medicationGroups for information matching the query. Return a clear, structured answer suitable for communicating to a clinic representative. Cite specific rules or field names where relevant.

tools.description: Record a completed COPD outpatient registration in LVR. Call this once all mandatory fields have been confirmed and validated. This ends the conversation with a successful outcome.

icd10.description: COPD diagnosis code: J44.0, J44.1, or J44.9

gold_group.description: GOLD group: A, B, or E

exacerbations_hospitalised_12m.description: Hospitalisations due to exacerbations last 12 months

tools.synthesisGuidance: Generate a formal LVR registration confirmation. Assign a reference number (format: LVR-2025-XXXXXX with a 6-digit number). Print a structured summary of all submitted fields. Close with a confirmation that the data has been accepted into the LVR registry and will be included in national quality reporting. Match the conversation language (Swedish or English).

tools.description: Reject a COPD registration when mandatory fields cannot be provided after negotiation. Call this only if critical mandatory data (spirometry or patient identity) is unavailable. This ends the conversation.

reason.description: Clear explanation of why the submission cannot be accepted

resubmission_guidance.description: What the clinic should do to complete a future submission

tools.synthesisGuidance: Generate a formal LVR rejection notice with today's date, a reference number (format: LVR-REJ-2025-XXXXXX), reason for rejection, list of missing fields, and constructive guidance on resubmission.

mandatoryFields: fev1_fvc_ratio — post-bronchodilator, must be < 0.70 to confirm obstruction
optionalButRecommended: mmrc_dyspnea (0-4, acceptable substitute if CAT not available)
rules: mMRC grade >= 2 OR CAT >= 10 indicates high symptom burden (relevant for GOLD group B/E determination)
mMRC is an accepted substitute for CAT when CAT has not been completed at the visit
Spirometry must be post-bronchodilator; pre-bronchodilator values are not accepted for GOLD grading
Exacerbation count includes both outpatient treatment courses (antibiotic and/or oral steroid) and inpatient hospitalisations
A single hospitalisation due to COPD exacerbation qualifies for GOLD group E regardless of symptom score

abeGroups.description: GOLD 2023 ABE groups combine symptom burden with exacerbation history
abeGroups.A: 0-1 exacerbations (none hospitalised) AND low symptoms (mMRC 0-1 or CAT < 10)
abeGroups.B: 0-1 exacerbations (none hospitalised) AND high symptoms (mMRC >= 2 or CAT >= 10)
abeGroups.E: >= 2 exacerbations in past year OR >= 1 hospitalisation due to COPD exacerbation — regardless of symptom score; E takes precedence over A and B

medicationGroups.LAMA: Long-acting muscarinic antagonist — e.g. tiotropium (R03BB04), umeclidinium (R03BB07)
